title: Rav Shaul Alter's Guidance
body: Rav Shaul Alter spoke to Yeshiva Derech Chaim talmidim in Yerushalayim, urging them to focus on avoiding hurtful words rather than fasting during Shovavim. He emphasized the importance of proper limud haTorah and spiritual growth.

title: Chareidi Newsline Operator Arrested
body: A chareidi news hotline operator was arrested for allegedly inciting protests, but a Yerushalayim judge ordered his release, rebuking police for their conduct and raising questions about freedom of expression.

title: Kashrus Standards at Risk
body: Senior Chief Rabbinate officials warn that importing Brazilian poultry could breach Israel's kashrus standards, posing severe consequences for kosher consumers.

title: Mrs. Sarah Zlata Segal Passes
body: Rav Simcha Zissel Broide's daughter, Mrs. Sarah Zlata Segal, passed away at 80 in Yerushalayim. A revered figure known for dignity & yiras Shamayim, she was rosh yeshiva Chevron Yeshiva's daughter.

title: Lost Hiker Rescued Safely
body: A female hiker was safely rescued after a nighttime search near Storm Mountain Trailhead following a coordinated search-and-rescue operation led by Matzil Search and Rescue.
